question.problem:
Some researchers want to test the belief that teenagers who play an instrument are more likely to be good at math. They collect data on a large sample of teenagers that play an instrument.

- $30%$ of teenagers play piano, and $50%$ of those teenagers are good at mathematics.

- $20%$ of teenagers play violin, and $60%$ of those teenagers are good at mathematics.

- $50%$ of teenagers play other instruments, and $47%$ of those teenagers are good at mathematics.

If $10%$ of teenagers started to play music before $6$ years old, and $58%$ of teenagers who started to play before $6$ years old are good at math, what is the probability that a randomly chosen teenager that is good at math started to play music before $6$ years old? Round your answer to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
Let $B$ be the event that a teenager started to play music before $6$ years old, $M$ be the event that a teenager is good at math, and ${T}_{1},{T}_{2},{T}_{3}$ be the events that a teenager plays piano, violin, or another instrument, respectively. 

Let's break down the information given in the problem statement:

- From the bullet points, we have the following information:

$$
\begin{aligned} & P({T}_{1})=0.3 &  & P(M|{T}_{1})=0.5 \\  & P({T}_{2})=0.2 &  & P(M|{T}_{2})=0.6 \\  & P({T}_{3})=0.5 &  & P(M|{T}_{3})=0.47\end{aligned}
$$

The disjoint union ${T}_{1}⊔{T}_{2}⊔{T}_{3}$ covers the entire sample space, and we have

$$
P({T}_{1})+P({T}_{2})+P({T}_{3})=0.3+0.2+0.5=1.
$$

- Since $10%$ of teenagers started to play before $6$ years old, we have

$$
P(B)=0.1.
$$

- Since $58%$ of students who started to play before $6$ years old are good at math, we have

$$
P(M|B)=0.58.
$$

We want to find the probability that a randomly chosen teenager who is good at math started to play before $6$ years old, which is represented as $P(B|M).$ 

Using Bayes' theorem combined with the law of total probability, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(B|M) & =\frac{P(M|B)P(B)}{P(M)} \\  & =\frac{P(M|B)P(B)}{P(M|{T}_{1})P({T}_{1})+P(M|{T}_{2})P({T}_{2})+P(M|{T}_{3})P({T}_{3})} \\  & =\frac{(0.58)(0.1)}{(0.5)(0.3)+(0.6)(0.2)+(0.47)(0.5)} \\  & =\frac{0.058}{0.505} \\  & ≈0.115,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
